arguments.name: positionName
arguments.description: The name of the Benefit Clearance Head position to edit (e.g., 'Admin Officer', 'Finance Head'). If not provided, the transformer will list all available positions for the user to choose from.

raw.name: positionName
raw.description: The name of the Benefit Clearance Head position to edit (e.g., 'Admin Officer', 'Finance Head'). If not provided, the transformer will list all available positions for the user to choose from.

arguments.name: employeeId
arguments.description: The employee ID to assign to this position (e.g., '000001', '000010'). The system will search for this employee ID and validate if the employee exists and is active.

raw.name: employeeId
raw.description: The employee ID to assign to this position (e.g., '000001', '000010'). The system will search for this employee ID and validate if the employee exists and is active.

arguments.name: newPositionName
arguments.description: The new name for the position if you want to rename it. If not provided, the position name stays the same.

raw.name: newPositionName
raw.description: The new name for the position if you want to rename it. If not provided, the position name stays the same.

arguments.name: createWorkflowApproval
arguments.description: Whether to enable workflow approval for this position. Use 'true' to enable or 'false' to disable. If not provided, the checkbox remains unchanged.

raw.name: createWorkflowApproval
raw.description: Whether to enable workflow approval for this position. Use 'true' to enable or 'false' to disable. If not provided, the checkbox remains unchanged.
